short: predicate after a long Romance subject
notes: Card: broad flag 1.3%; es, be, un, seront, he, son, sont, seinen: mostly verbs after long subjects in Spanish and French. Probes: long Spanish subject 0.603 and 0.385, French 0.185-0.232; a short 'La casa es grande' 0.103; an English translation 0.242. Near misses are English translations, which is a weak contrast: this tests language plus position, not a meaning.
